text: 1. The photocopy of passport(photo page and China visa page. Valid for more than one year); 2. One passport-size photo with a white background; 3. Diploma and transcripts: Copy of the final diploma and corresponding transcripts(Applicant for Preppie Program should provide high school graduation certificate and high school transcripts ). 4. Physical Examination Materials: If applicant applies from abroad, he must submit the scanned “Foreigner Physical Examination Form” within the validity period. If the applicant has already stayed in China, he must submit the scanned “Certificate of Verification(For Physical Examination Record for Foreigner or Overseas Chinese” (including the Physical Examination Report) within the validity period; 5. Proof of Economic Ability(only for Preppie Program applicant) 6. A complete“Beijing Information Science & Technology University (BISTU) Application Form for International Students”(Annex 1); 7. A complete “Beijing Information Science & Technology University (BISTU) Information Form for International Students’ Family Members”(Annex 2); 8. Applicant who is under 18, must provide the original copy of the notarized legal guardian form issued by Notary Public Office in Beijing and the scanned passports of parents. Additional remarks: The application documents must be real and complete. Non-Chinese or English documents must provide notarized translations in Chinese or English. All the documents will NOT be refunded.
